note: Tempdoc 602 R6 + register F-052 — the per-query search-trace DEGRADATION reason vocabularies are closed authorities, the search-side sibling of readiness-reason-codes.v1.json (NOT merged with it — separate vocabularies, per tempdoc 600 PART IX). Each entry in `vocabularies` pairs ONE Java producer enum with ONE FE wording table in searchTraceExplain.ts. The gate (scripts/ci/check-search-degradation-reason-codes.mjs) enforces correspondence per vocabulary so neither drifts: FORWARD = every non-exempt enum member is worded (so a degraded search-explain line can never show the raw `(CODE)` to the user — the Nielsen 'no error codes' invariant); BACKWARD = every wording key is a real enum member or a declared feDerived one (no dead/typo rows). The noWordingExempt lists are the only curated artifacts: a code is exempt when it structurally cannot reach the user-tier summary line, so wording it would be dead UI.

vocabularies.why: The worker `SearchReasonCode` enum's `.name()` wire strings populate the three user-tier degradation fields (vectorBlockedReason / hybridFallbackReason / spladeSkipReason). Encoding failures carry the failure reasons; deliberate planner-owned dense skips carry a separate typed denseSkipReason and project through vectorBlockedReason without masquerading as an encoding failure. The FE `DEGRADATION_REASON_WORDING` map words them.

vocabularies.why: Register F-052 (production side). A rerank deadline miss or RPC drop delivered fusion order with NO user-visible signal: the reason existed only as the `cross-encoder` trace stage's raw code, and the stage list is a diagnostic-tier facet inside the collapsed disclosure. The head-owned `CrossEncoderSkipReason` enum closes that vocabulary (it also normalises the worker's RerankResponse.skip_reason, so an unrecognised worker string becomes UNKNOWN instead of an unworded pass-through) and the FE `CROSS_ENCODER_SKIP_WORDING` map words the DROP class into the user-tier summary line. Register F-054 extended the drop class with INFERENCE_FAILED: the worker stamped DEADLINE_EXCEEDED on ANY reranker skip, so an ONNX Runtime memory-arena exhaustion — measured at 199/200 of a campaign's 'deadline misses', unfixable by any deadline value — reached the user as 'ran out of time'. DEADLINE_EXCEEDED now means only a budget pre-check.

noWordingExempt.why: by-design skip (`isDrop()==false`) — the pipeline chose not to rerank a navigational query; nothing degraded, so it never reaches the user-tier line
by-design skip — reranking is switched off in configuration

by-design skip — the active preset has no cross-encoder stage
no reranker model is configured on this host — an install/capability state owned by the readiness-notice channel (classifyConsequence's optional-capability caveat), not a per-query degradation
